slots.label: Figure 3
slots.default: IT Support, Managed Cloud Services, IT for Business Services

slots.label: Paragraph 2
slots.default: For a growing, people-focused organisation, IT has to just work: staff spread across locations, learners depending on systems being available, and a leadership team that needs technology handled so it can focus on delivery. Getting the initial setup right, and having genuinely responsive support behind it, was the priority.

slots.label: Paragraph 4
slots.default: WhizzIT handled the setup of the group’s IT environment and has provided ongoing support ever since. Every interaction is handled personally, clear communication, quick responses and a team that takes ownership of issues until they’re resolved.

slots.label: Paragraph 6
slots.default: Across more than 140 supported staff, issues are picked up the same working day and resolved in an average of 1 hour 20 minutes. The CEO describes working with WhizzIT as a revelation: an amazing setup experience, outstanding customer service, and the confidence of knowing the organisation’s IT is in safe hands.
